sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the ship target, calculation-case relationship, evidenced conditional positive-shear selection, required qualified positive case, owner-specific operands, exact Cf envelope constants, unit conversion from MN to kN, and tolerance-scaled derived FI comparison.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not apply gen:I2_051_PositiveShearCaseShape through sh:node to every nltl:hasCalculationCase value, because that incorrectly requires all calculation cases linked to the ship to be positive-shear cases. Preserve the generic sh:class nltl:calculationCase constraint, but use a qualified value shape (with the required qualified cardinality) to select the positive-shear case or cases having nltl:shearForceDirection nltl:positiveShearForce and a longitudinal position. Continue applying the bounded formula query only to those selected positive-shear cases, while permitting unrelated or negative-shear calculation cases.

Preserve the qualified positive-shear selection required by the prior feedback, but also validate every linked case that has nltl:shearForceDirection nltl:positiveShearForce. Currently only one qualified case must satisfy gen:PositiveShearCaseShape, while any additional positive-shear case lacking a valid longitudinal-position quantity is skipped by the SPARQL inner join and can pass accidentally. Apply a SHACL Core conditional wrapper to each nltl:hasCalculationCase value: cases without the positive controlled value may pass that branch, whereas cases having it must conform to gen:PositiveShearCaseShape; retain the generic calculationCase class constraint and qualified minimum. Keep the bounded formula query for those validated positive cases. Also encode the exact regulatory Cf constants as equal lower/upper inclusive conditions (equivalently, violations below or above 0.0 and 1.0) rather than using !=, while retaining tolerance only for the derived FI result.

Preserve the qualified positive-shear selection, generic calculationCase constraint, exact Cf bounds, and bounded formula query from the prior repairs, but prevent linked cases with missing branch-selection evidence from passing the conditional wrapper. Require every nltl:hasCalculationCase value evaluated by gen:CalculationCaseConditionalShape to have at least one nltl:shearForceDirection value; then retain the alternatives so a case containing nltl:positiveShearForce must conform to gen:PositiveShearCaseShape, while an evidenced non-positive case may take the other branch. The current sh:not/sh:hasValue branch succeeds when shearForceDirection is absent, creating accidental-pass logic and omitting the declared relationship on those cases.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship target, calculation-case relationship, evidenced conditional positive-shear selection, required qualified positive case, owner-specific operands, exact Cf envelope constants, unit conversion from MN to kN, and tolerance-scaled derived FI comparison.
